name: 3S Elemental
author: Joakim
description: The Elemental guild HUD, fed by the Guild.Info, Guild.State, Guild.Extra and Guild.Skills GMCP packages (3Scapes only). Tabs: Status (guild title, form, size, the energy pool and the vortexes as bars, the reset clock with the time until it turns, every defence - negation, barrier, wave, siphon, engulfed, diffused, dissipated - with the damage types it is covering, the energy shield, the charges - blasts, waves and natural convergence, which the reset clock gives back, then engulfs and shrouds, which come back at the daily reset - and the panic setting), Energy (the gexp still owed for the next guild level and how long that takes at the pace of the last ten minutes, the lifetime / used / to spend / link totals, and what this session has gained), Skills (every skill against its total, and what its next level costs - light green at its total, yellow when the energy to spend covers the next level, orange with how much is missing when it does not; left-click a skill for 'info', right-click to 'enhance' it) and Setup (panic hp and action, resolve, the emit power output, prismatic emission, equipollent and consistency). 'elhud' prints the Status page into the output window. Another guild's same-named packages are ignored, and after a gswap the panel says which guild the character is in now. 0.1.0 (25 Nov 2026): built from an afternoon's captures of a Time elemental.
